challenges.title: Assumption-sensitive rational rewrite identities
challenges.mathematicalObject: parameterized rational expression rewrite with explicit nonzero assumptions
challenges.candidateRepresentation: directed AST pattern pair plus normalized assumption predicates

independentEvaluator.method: cross-multiply under declared nonzero denominators, compare exact polynomial normal forms, and search bounded rational counterexamples
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: transcendental functions, undeclared branch cuts, or assumptions not expressible in the normalized predicate language

challenges.certificateRoute: solver-neutral obligation with denominator assumptions and retained symbolic result
challenges.splitUnit: denominator-factor topology and normalized placeholder-incidence signature
challenges.multipleSolutionPolicy: credit every distinct valid normalized rule; do not require equality with a hidden reference
challenges.nullResultPolicy: retain zero-output, refuted, unsupported, timeout, and incomplete-assumption outcomes
challenges.pilotRequirement: verify denominator-assumption propagation and false-positive rejection on development-only examples
challenges.selectionRationale: extends beyond coefficient collection while retaining exact symbolic evaluation and explicit side-condition failure modes

challenges.title: Finite-difference and recurrence hypotheses for integer sequences
challenges.mathematicalObject: integer sequence prefix with a separate continuation holdout
challenges.candidateRepresentation: normalized finite-difference polynomial or bounded recurrence with declared order and assumptions

independentEvaluator.method: evaluate the frozen recurrence on held-out terms and verify finite-difference or recurrence consistency over the declared finite domain
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: does not prove uniqueness of an infinite sequence or external novelty

challenges.certificateRoute: domain-specific finite-data witness plus optional solver obligation for the recurrence relation
leakageControls: database lookup after candidate freeze only
challenges.multipleSolutionPolicy: retain all valid hypotheses and score coverage, simplicity, and ambiguity separately
challenges.nullResultPolicy: retain no-fit, multiple-fit, unsupported-order, timeout, and failed-holdout outcomes
challenges.pilotRequirement: characterize ambiguous finite prefixes and ensure no unique-infinite-sequence claim is emitted
challenges.selectionRationale: uses a distinct mathematical object type with a cheap holdout evaluator and explicit ambiguity semantics

challenges.title: Reusable symbolic macro and search-strategy discovery
challenges.mathematicalObject: bounded composition of semantics-preserving transformations reused across frozen task families
challenges.candidateRepresentation: versioned macro operator with ordered primitive steps, applicability guards, and assumptions

independentEvaluator.method: verify every primitive step and compare baseline versus macro-enabled search under identical held-out inputs, targets, inventory, strategy, and budgets
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: utility is not truth, novelty, or mathematical importance

challenges.certificateRoute: replayable derivation trace plus paired utility and regression report
challenges.splitUnit: transformation motif, source family, and macro-structure signature
challenges.multipleSolutionPolicy: compare every valid macro independently; equivalent step sequences share one normalized identity
challenges.nullResultPolicy: retain no-macro, no-gain, trade-off, regression, timeout, and unsupported-task outcomes
challenges.pilotRequirement: measure candidate volume and duplicate collapse while preserving exact primitive-step provenance
challenges.selectionRationale: offers a systems-level discovery target with directly measurable reusable utility and independently checkable step semantics

challenges.title: Sign-sensitive inequality-preserving transformations
challenges.mathematicalObject: parameterized inequality transformation with sign and domain conditions
challenges.candidateRepresentation: directed relation pattern, comparison-direction effect, and normalized sign assumptions

independentEvaluator.method: translate supported polynomial inequalities and assumptions to the solver-neutral IR, request refutation or confirmation, and search bounded rational counterexamples
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: non-polynomial ordering, incomplete sign assumptions, and translation loss

challenges.certificateRoute: solver-neutral inequality obligation with assumption and translation evidence
challenges.splitUnit: comparison-direction transition, sign-context topology, and polynomial structure signature
challenges.multipleSolutionPolicy: credit distinct valid transformations with non-equivalent assumption sets separately
challenges.nullResultPolicy: retain unknown, unsupported, missing-assumption, refuted, and timeout outcomes
challenges.pilotRequirement: build a domain adapter and demonstrate that missing or weakened sign assumptions fail closed
challenges.selectionRationale: scientifically useful but deferred until assumption propagation and relation-direction semantics have dedicated production evidence

challenges.title: Small finite combinatorial construction improvement
challenges.mathematicalObject: bounded finite graph or set-system construction with exact validity and objective score
challenges.candidateRepresentation: canonical finite object plus constructive operation lineage
formationInformation: objective function without hidden best-known target

independentEvaluator.method: check every constraint exactly and compute the declared objective; exhaustively verify selected small sizes where feasible
independentEvaluator.unsupportedBoundary: scales only to preregistered finite sizes and does not prove asymptotic optimality

challenges.certificateRoute: canonical object, constraint-check receipt, objective score, and optional exhaustive optimality certificate at small size
challenges.splitUnit: object size, constraint topology, and construction-operator signature
challenges.multipleSolutionPolicy: retain all non-isomorphic valid constructions at each objective score
challenges.nullResultPolicy: retain invalid, duplicate, no-improvement, timeout, and incomplete-exhaustion outcomes
challenges.pilotRequirement: add a generic finite-construction domain, isomorphism-aware identity, and bounded exact evaluator
challenges.selectionRationale: potentially strong objective results but deferred because no current production domain adapter or canonical isomorphism layer exists
